advanced.slots_help: Highlighted slots are in use; a dot means the slot is bound to a key.
advanced.help_empty: Choose a type to create an advanced key in this slot.
advanced.help_dks: Dynamic keystroke: up to 4 output keys, each acting at 4 travel points (pressing past point 1, reaching point 2 at the bottom, leaving point 3 upwards, passing point 4 upwards).
advanced.help_mod_tap: Mod-tap: a quick tap sends one action, holding past the threshold sends another.
advanced.help_toggle: Toggle: a tap latches the action down, the next tap releases it.
advanced.help_other: This slot holds a type the app cannot edit (RS / RKRT or unknown). It is kept as read.
advanced.mt_hold_help: Sent when the key is held past the threshold.
advanced.mt_threshold_help: How long the key must be held to count as held.
advanced.clear_confirm: Clear slot A%1? Its settings are lost when you apply.
advanced.clear_bound: Clear this slot? Keys bound to it (%1) get their default function back.
advanced.bind_help: Click a key to make it use slot A%1; click it again to give it its default function back.
advanced.socd_help: Decides what happens when both keys of a pair are held, e.g. A and D.
advanced.socd_hotkey: Fn + Right Shift switches it on the keyboard too.
